name: highlighter
title: Highlighter
description: Wraps a phrase so a rough, hand-drawn stroke draws over it: a highlighter wash, an underline, a box and other styles, each in a colour you choose.
use: A few words in a headline need emphasis that looks drawn by hand rather than printed.
avoid: Dense body text or many marked phrases, where repeated rough strokes become noisy and slow to read.
a11y: The strokes are decorative, but the draw animation ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two lines of white text on black. On the first, a pale yellow band with torn, uneven edges sits behind the words "highlighted text" and overhangs them slightly. On the second, "underline mode" carries a wavy cyan rule and "box style" is enclosed in a shaky purple rectangle.
behaves: Once the wrapped text is on screen, the chosen stroke draws itself on over less than a second in two passes, leaving a marker-like uneven edge. It redraws if the text changes size.
customise: The phrase is children; the action (highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through and more), colour, stroke width, draw time, passes, padding and multiline are props.
weight: light: A few SVG paths per phrase that draw once, then sit idle.
demo: Sentences reading "The highlighted text draws across on view" and "Switch to underline mode or box style for variety"
polishWhy: The hand-drawn strokes read convincingly and stay legible; edge alignment varies slightly per pass.
